title: A relayed owner ruling cites the question it answered, and the send-time judge checks the relayed rule is no wider than that question
why: Retrospective 14:03 CST Nov 13, its own mistake at 13:29: it relayed "round 3 no longer occurs" as a rule for every change, when the owner was answering item 741 (skip round 3 after a pass). Round 3 was wrongly dropped from lanes for about 30 minutes. INCIDENT 19:05 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 19:04, its own error; triage chose this step over question-checks-rulings-first, which covers questions only, and over a new step, rule building-one-home-per-capability): at 00:25 CST Nov 14 the coordinator relayed an unfiled rule (step review-nit-not-fail, a consultant relay, no owner ruling) to a lane as a "lane rule"; the #3367 lane scored its round 2 PASS over its reviewer's own FAIL on it. Harm: a failed round read as passed; the coordinator told lane review-policy-as-data on 19:04 that round 2 is FAIL and round 3 with the net-value test is owed (owner 741), and told runner 10 to hold #3367 out. GUARD (extension): a relayed rule names its filed home, a ruling id or a decision and line, or says "no filed ruling". First act of a lane: find where relays are checked today (kin: step past-ruling-on-send, the send-time judge) and add this check; red then green: a relay that states a rule with no ruling id, decision line or "no filed ruling" is refused. Rule: building-mistake-names-its-guard. Triage read no relay text; which other lanes used the unfiled rule is unchecked (runner 10 asked).
note: Todo, candidate. Guard: a relayed ruling names the item or question it answered; the send-time judge (SendMessage wording judge, step past-ruling-on-send) checks the relayed rule is no wider than that question. Red case: the 13:2x relay against item 741. Triage's own relays of the same words (13:31 and later, ruling r9 text) took the wide reading too and were corrected 14:0x CST. Past rulings not checked.
